context:
Goal: the Orphaned composer sits the right distance above the keyboard.
Problem (goal): your ruling set a 56 pt gap above the keys, but the build on PR 389 ships 12 pt, while the invariant and a debt record still say 56, so only you can say which number is right.
Based on (ruling): your 2026-11-21 20:27 CST answer: build the Orphaned composer margin as drawn.
Based on (read): on the iPhone the reported keyboard top already includes the 44 pt strip, so 56 pt above it was about 100 pt above the keys; the Duo gap is unmeasured.
Departs from: main and your ruling say 56 pt above the keys — the build ships 12 pt.
Waiting on: your answer; PR 389 waits, the other lanes run.

options.gain: The composer sits close to the keys and matches the iPhone as measured.
options.how: The coordinator changes the rule that the screen never moves under your finger and the open note on the composer to 12 pt, and PR 389 merges.
options.label: Accept 12 pt
options.lose: The 56 pt you drew is no longer the rule, and the Duo gap stays unmeasured.

options.how: A builder restores the 56 pt margin on PR 389.
options.label: Bring back 56 pt
options.lose: The composer floats about 100 pt above the keys on the iPhone, as the read shows.

short: Orphaned composer margin: accept 12 pt or bring back 56 pt
title: Is a 12 pt gap above the keys accepted for the Orphaned composer, or must 56 pt return?
why: On the iPhone 56 pt above the reported keyboard top already measured about 100 pt above the keys; this is my reading, and the Duo is unmeasured.
